patch.summary: Is Demandbase worth it? Enterprise account-based experience platform (Demandbase One) that unifies account intelligence, buying signals, advertising, and sales/marketing orchestration for B2B revenue teams.. Strong when Enterprise B2B teams running account-based marketing and sales orchestration. Weak when Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices.

sections.heading: Demandbase: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs contact data and Enterprise B2B teams running account-based marketing and sales orchestration holds. Counter-signal: Walk when Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Demandbase One.

sections.heading: Who Demandbase is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Demandbase when enterprise account-based orchestration (data + engagement + ABM) is the buying job and you can run a custom-quote evaluation..

Avoid if: Compare 6sense for predictive ABM peers, ZoomInfo for deeper contact databases, and Apollo for self-serve data+engagement..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with 6sense on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Demandbase price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
